topic: SP-077.1.a4: check the unlock in Orch.app by hand
detail: Needs the user with a policy applied and Orch.app built from the PR (make app-install): run 'orch spaces unlock --for 5m' in a terminal; check the menu bar panel shows the request with that command, the terminal (tty) and 5 min; Confirm (Touch ID or password), type the code the panel shows into the terminal; check the panel counts down and 'orch spaces diff' works in that shell; Lock it; ask again and Deny. Touch ID and the password prompt cannot be driven by a unit test (the tests inject a confirmer).
